notes.title: Patch Notes 7214_413
notes.notes:
Along with updating to Unreal Engine 5.3, the team has been working diligently on crushing bugs, improving systems, player messaging, new weapons, game balancing, and polishing. Check out our updates!

[b]Highlights[/b]
[list]
[*] Cascading Hitscans
[*] Updating and improving AI logic
[*] Updated Animation System
[*] New and Updated VO's
[*] Nyx - Turret has been replaced with Blockade
[/list]

[b]Weapon Updates[/b]
[list]
[*] Picking up the same weapon will now have an upgrade for some weapons!
[/list]

---

[b]Ion Pistol[/b]
[list]
[*] Upgraded will allow you to shoot an emp upon ADS
[/list]

[b]Auto Rifle[/b]
[list]
[*] Upgraded will allow you to shoot a rifle grenade upon ADS
[/list]

[b]LMG[/b]
[list]
[*] Upgraded will give you a forward shield
[/list]

[b]Ranger[/b]
[list]
[*] New Weapon!
[/list]

[b]Arc Bolt[/b]
[list]
[*] New Weapon!
[/list]

[b]Double Barrel Shotgun[/b]
[list]
[*] Upgraded will give you a grappling hook upon ADS
[/list]

[b]Sidewinder[/b]
[list]
[*] New Weapon!
[/list]

[b]Kinetic Weapons[/b]
[list]
[*] Gated by Weight Type
[*] Nyx Healing Gun
[*] Skrill Minigun
[*] Piko Knives
[/list]

[b]Honor Blade (Melee)[/b]
[list]
[*] Secondary Ability - will allow you to slash through an opponent
[*] Upgraded allows you to dual-wield
[/list]

[b]The Mangler (Melee)[/b]
[list]
[*] Secondary Ability - will allow you to shoot a spike
[/list]

[b]Bot Boster[/b]
[list]
[*] Secondary Ability - will allow you to block
[/list]

[b]EMP[/b]
[list]
[*] Will disable one random ability, as well as drain Kinetic Charge and do damage to shields
[/list]

[b]SFX[/b]
[list]
[*] Hitscan impacts (For different weight classes)
[*] Impalement sounds (For different weight classes)
[*] Melee Attack (For different weight classes)
[*] Match Intro
[*] Character Main Menu Intro
[/list]

[b]UX/UI[/b]
[list]
[*] Contextual popup widget in the HUD
[*] Updated hit effects
[*] Spec descriptions
[*] Updated Throwdown descriptions
[*] Added Kinetic Cost and Cooldown descriptions for characters
[*] Icon Updates
[*] Updated UI Scaling
[*] Navigation Issues
[*] Character Selection icons now captures your character
[*] Scoreboard improvements
[*] Match Intro and End Sequence Updates
[*] Weapon Reward UI at the end of the match
[*] Updated Loading Screens
[/list]

[b]Holograms[/b]
[list]
[*] Paul Betraydeez & Throwdown: The Popcorn Must Flow
[*] Joan of Arc & Throwdown: Divine Intervention
[/list]

[b]Gamemode Additions[/b]
[list]
[*] Data Dash
[*] Free For All
[/list]

[b]Bugfixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where character skins weren't loading correctly
[*] Fixed an issue with profiles and frames not loading
[*] Fixed Play Button Options not being disabled
[*] Fixed loading screen text not being formatted correctly
[*] Fixed players not being able to spawn in after the match intro timer end
[*] Fixed camera sequence not stopping in the match
[*] Fixed AI crashing the game at the end of the match
[*] Fixed metrics not being sent
[*] Fixed Encrypted Vault Back not working on purchase
[*] Fixed players in parties not being able to rejoin the game upon leaving
[*] Fixed training missing a hud
[*] Fixed not being able to load the training map
[*] Fixed A pose in tutorial and training
[*] Fixed data layer issue with data dash on Zoranium Mines
[*] Fixed minimap colors for some players being wrong
[*] Fixed a potential crash with loading player data
[*] Fixed tutorial having Free For All team
[*] Fixed load renderable item sometimes not completing
[*] Fixed weapons not attached to players on respawn
[*] Fixed the grey player Zoran popup in the HUD whenever a new player joins
[*] Fixed VO overlap fixes
[*] Fixed duplicate data dash beacon fix
[*] Fixed previews in store for bundles
[/list]

notes.title: Back to Class (Version B.0.0.5325_15)
notes.notes:
[b]New System Features[/b] [list]
[*] Store legibility and functionality improvements.
[*] Party system improvements (You should stay on the same team when joining a match)
[*] Limited Daily Z-Chips to Nova Credits conversion option.
[*] New loading screens featuring Jive. Press to continue!
[*] Skins V2. You can now customize your skin per part! (Arms, legs, torso, head)
[*] New replay features! Capture your favorite moments!
[*] All players have access to hosting servers and by extension the server browser
[*] Milestones: One time completable challenges increases progression significantly [/list]
[b]New Gameplay Features[/b] [list]
[*] New ping system (Currently mapped to 7 & 8). Communicate with your team!
[*] New Launch Pads. Get around in style!
[*] New emote wheel! Hold T to choose your emote! [/list]
[b]New Class Features[/b]
New Classes and Abilities Released: [list]
[*] Raze [list]
[*] Adrenaline Rush: Increases damage & fire rate by 15% for 10s
[*] Second Wind: Increased Kinetic Charge and Health Regen
[*] Dodge roll [/list]
[*] Nyx [list]
[*] Turret 2.0: New model and anims, more health, placed instead of thrown [/list]
[*] Skrill [list]
[*] Removed charge jump (Needs reworked)
[*] Reworked Skrill Sprint [/list]
[*] Piko [list]
[*] Invisibility: Vanishes from view, more effective when not moving. Turrets cannot target you, drops if you fire. [/list] [/list]
[b]New Gamemode[/b] [list]
[*] Zippin' Zchips: Race around the map to capture a rotating control point before the time runs out. Most captures wins! [/list]
[b]New Visual Features[/b] [list]
[*] New fullbody models for all classes.
[*] New holograms added to store [list]
[*] Elias Tusk
[*] Clark Suckerberg [/list]
[*] New skins added to store [/list]
[b]UI / UX[/b] [list]
[*] Ingame HUD coloration adjusted for Health, Shield, and Kinetic charge
[*] New indicators alerting low health
[*] Side mouse button icon
[*] Titlescreen layout readjustments [/list]
[b]Balance Changes[/b] [list]
[*] Revamped Time to Kill: Weapons have been significantly rebalanced across the board and class' stats have been reevaluated. Each life should be more meaningful. [/list]
[b]Known Issues[/b] [list]
[*] Team distribution on dedicated server can be inconsistent
[*] Occasional UI clearing issues present in store and item descriptions
[*] Picking up ammunition when unarmed may cause a crash
[*] If you host a match and the gamemode is King of the Hill, there will be no score
[*] Animation errors on party members on main menu [/list]

notes.title: Minor Patch Update August 16th (Version A.0.0.166)
notes.notes:
[b][u]New System Features[/u][/b]
- Store is now active! (Your inventory will start empty, but there are lots of free skins available!)

[u][b]New Gameplay Features[/b][/u]
- New soft lock for Melee Weapon (While using a melee weapon your camera will automatically track your target)

[u][b]New Visual Features[/b][/u]
- New effects added when the Overclock state engages
- Camera now spectates killer on death (Let us know what you think!)
- New Attachments
- New Skins
- Melee weapons now has visual effects for impact
- Melee weapons now have an effect associated with their passive (Lifesteal / Shield Stacking)
- Sniper has more visual flare when firing

[b][u]UI / UX[/u][/b]
- Quit match option added at round end
- MVP is now displayed for objective based gamemodes at round end
- Store has been redesigned

[b][u]New Audio Features[/u][/b]
-New Sound FX queues added to control points and throwdowns

[b][u]Maps[/u][/b]
- New assets added to The Hall V2

[b][u]New Holograms[/u][/b]
- Lady Fawkes
- Nash
- Some Holograms have multiple outfits! Press on them again to see.

[b][u]New Close Range Throwdowns[/u][/b]
- Mr. Likeable

[b][u]Balance Changes[/u][/b]
- Melee has been rebalanced significantly
- Stagger is no longer as punishing (Looking at you, melee)
- Energy Beam (throwdown) aiming sensitivity increased

[b][u]Bug Fixes[/u][/b]
- Training area is now working
- Weapon orientation issues for Throwdowns have been resolved
- Performance degradation issues may be resolved (Needs further testing)
- Hitch on Weapon Swap may be resolved (Needs further testing)

[b][u]Known Issues[/u][/b]
- Occasionally the loadout select screen will persist on spawn
- Game mode roulette is currently not working
- Occasionally leaving a match will sometimes make you unable to join a new one without restart
- Spectator cam can have some jitter
- AI can spawn in A poses (This issue resolves itself on respawn)
- Bullets can pass through the roof of Temple and Shrine on Hall V2
- End of match sequence can cause issues
- Sometimes cosmetic changes aren't reflected in game from the title screen
- Equipment screen is a little cluttered

Dedicated servers (Will be enabled for special events)

[u][b]New Gameplay Features[/b][/u]
Knockback and stagger added
Ammo pickups added and Weapon pickups reduced
General map adjustments for balancing

[u][b]Throwdowns[/b][/u]
Kill streaks activate "Overclock" state (Enables the use of throwdowns -> "F" and "G" keys)
Close range and long range throwdowns added

[b][u]New Close Range Throwdowns[/u][/b]
GetVerified2.0
Z - Kick

[b][u]New Long Range Throwdowns[/u][/b]
Energy Blast
Energy Beam

New screen effects when damage is taken

Chasebar for Health

[b][u]Maps[/u][/b]
New assets added to The Hall V2
Train added to Zenith Junction

[b][u]UI / UX[/u][/b]
New global leaderboard for kills
Friend panel updates and fixes
Party system

[b][u]New Audio Features[/u][/b]
General
New music added
New sound FX added to Throwdowns

[b][u]Balance Changes[/u][/b]
Proximity mine timer reduced in half
Sniper firing rate reduced

[b][u]Bug Fixes[/u][/b]
Re-fixed incorrect weapon animations on spawn
Melee improvement to make hits more reliable

notes.title: Bugfix / Feature Update Patch A.0.0.76
notes.notes:

Performance and Graphics Enhancements
Performance improvements
Environmental lighting improvements
Reworked Match Start up Sequence

[b][u]AI Bot Updates[/u][/b]
AI is now smarter

[b][u]Sound Design Improvements[/u][/b]
Redesigned sound effects for most weapons
Remixed overall sound levels

[u][b]Gameplay Additions[/b][/u]
Map roulette
New melee combo animation
New Aerial Attack and Charge Dash

New Animation and VFX for Double Jump (Thanks AdeptMasterN8!)

Training Map HDRI

notes.title: Minor Bug Fix Patch - A.0.0.71
notes.notes:
- Nameplates and outlines for players should now display properly on first spawn.
- Player / Bot join messages should now have team colors if assigned on non-host clients.
- Slightly increased the accuracy on pistol / reduced spread from movement.
- Halved time between shots for Burst Rifle.
- Tab Scoreboard in game should now update properly for non-host clients.
- Grenade (Q) has slightly less bounce and a bit more gravity.
- Explosions (Grenades / Rockets) were not registering all hits properly, this is now fixed!
